Name: Red Panda Bazaar
Author: WhaleK233
TagLine: This is a new expansion mod for Stardew Valley which adds 3 new NPCs, some locations, a few shops and a new festival!
Description:
[align=center]
# **English**
[spoiler]
## **New NPCs**
RPB adds three NPCs with distinctive personalities, including two marriageable female NPCs with 8 sets of post-marriage dialogues.

## **New Locations**
RPB adds a sign next to the bus providing access to the Red Panda Bazaar.
There are many shops in the market selling different items. You can buy what you need at different points in the game.
A lottery machine has been added to the bazaar, and tickets can be purchased from a certain NPC's store.

## **New Food**
RPB adds a lot of new foods, and some foods have special buffs, adding fun and help to your game progress.

## **New Festival**
RPB adds a new festival on the 8th day of spring: the Spring Fair.
At that time, residents of Red Panda Bazaar and Pelican Town will come here to sell their respective products.
You can also play mini games to get star tokens to redeem rewards!

## **New decoration**
RPB adds some new furniture and new clothes to give you more personalization options!

## **Future Update**
More NPCs, more events, more mini-games and more creativity! 

## **Localization**
Welcome localization!

## **Compatibility**
Red Panda Bazaar is compatible with SVE, RSV and East Scarp.
Red Panda Bazaar is also compatible with [Qingfeng - Custom NPC](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24934) (but it is not recommended to install both two).
If you meet any bugs, please submit them to us!

## **Contact**
Please join our [discord](https://discord.gg/byuuW4SgA4)!
You can also send email.

## **Donation**
If you like Red Panda Bazaar, maybe a cup of [coffee](https://ko-fi.com/lilaoliu)?
[/spoiler]

# **中文**
[spoiler]

## **新的NPC**
添加了3个性格鲜明可社交的NPC，其中包含两个可婚的女性NPC，具有8套婚后对话。

## **新地点**
在公交车旁添加了一块竖牌，可通过其进入小熊猫集市。
集市内有很多商店，售卖各不相同的物品，在游戏的不同时期都可以买到需要的东西。
集市添加了一个抽奖机，可以从某个NPC的商店购买获得抽奖券。

## **新食物**
添加了很多新食物，部分食物具有特殊Buff，为你的游戏进程添加乐趣和帮助。

## **新节日**
在春季第8天添加了一个新节日：春季展览会。
届时小熊猫和鹈鹕镇的居民们会来此售卖各自的产品。
你也可以游玩小游戏获取星星币来兑换奖励！

## **新装饰**
添加了一些新家具和新衣服，给予你更多的个性化选择！

## **未来更新**
更多NPC、更多事件、更多小游戏和更多创意！

## **兼容性**
Red Panda Bazaar 与 SVE、RSV 和 East Scarp 均兼容。
Red Panda Bazaar 也兼容 [Qingfeng - Custom NPC](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24934) (但不建议同时安装)。
如果你发现任何Bug，欢迎提交给我们！

## **联系方式**
